structure: Main prediction with a hedge: something dangerous could happen, but it will probably end safely.
Danger 1: the reversing car and the boy behind it (point to the clues).
Danger 2: the ball rolling into the road and the approaching car; what the crossing guard will do.
Other things that will happen (the bus leaving) and the final outcome.
modelAnswer: I think something dangerous could happen in the next few seconds, but hopefully it'll end safely. In the middle of the parking lot, a red car is backing out of its spot. Its reverse lights are on, so it's moving backwards. Right behind the car, a boy in a green shirt is running after a red ball, which is rolling toward the road. So, first of all, the driver might not see him at all. My guess is that someone, maybe the woman by the minivan, will shout, and the driver will slam on the brakes just in time. Second, the ball is going to roll into the street, where a blue car is coming. Luckily, there's a crossing guard with a stop sign right there, so he'll probably step into the road with his sign and stop the traffic. Meanwhile, the two kids on the sidewalk will get on the school bus, and it'll pull away. After that, I'm sure the boy will get a serious talk about parking lot safety.

usefulExpressions.expression: …could happen, but hopefully it'll end safely
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Dự đoán có mức độ chắc chắn khác nhau (could / hopefully) — rất tự nhiên ở Level 8+

usefulExpressions.expression: is backing out of its spot
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Đang lùi xe ra khỏi chỗ đỗ

usefulExpressions.expression: …will slam on the brakes just in time
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Đạp phanh gấp vừa kịp lúc
May là có… ngay đó, nên… — nối manh mối với kết quả
Xe (buýt) sẽ rời đi / chạy khỏi chỗ đỗ

commonMistakes: Nói 'the car is going back' → dùng 'the car is reversing' hoặc 'backing out'.
Chỉ dự đoán điều xấu ('the boy will die') mà không có kết thúc hợp lý; nên nêu cả nguy cơ và cách tình huống có thể được giải quyết.
Quên giải thích vì sao bạn dự đoán như vậy; mỗi dự đoán nên đi kèm một manh mối trong tranh (đèn lùi, quả bóng, biển STOP).
